lines.text: Many learners say: We arrived to the airport at six.
Better: We arrived at the airport at six.
At! We arrived at the hotel.

data.wrong: We arrived to the airport at six.
data.right: We arrived at the airport at six.

native.hook: “Đến sân bay” nói sao cho đúng?
native.tip: Tiếng Việt nói “đến sân bay”, nên dễ ghép “to.” Tiếng Anh nói “arrive at.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “We arrived to the airport at six.” không? 😅 Sau “arrive”, hãy dùng “at”: “We arrived at the airport at six.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “at.” Hãy viết một câu về lần bạn đến một nơi, dùng “arrived at.” Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Say “arrive at” a place, not “arrive to.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “We arrived to the airport at six.” After “arrive”, use “at”: “We arrived at the airport at six.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
